say:2:1222705001:1.text: Hey, Jaxon! We've recovered all the coins you dropped!
say:2:1222705001:1.source_cn: 学者先生，你掉的金币都找回来啦！

say:3:1222705002:1.text: Great... Fortunately, not a single coin is missing! It's lucky I ran into you.
say:3:1222705002:1.source_cn: 呼……还好，一枚金币也没少！万幸遇到了你们。

say:4:1222705003:1.text: Now, I just need to wait for <style="highlight">dusk to come</style>! Then, I'll use my gold as bait to catch the golden peacock!
say:4:1222705003:1.source_cn: 接下来只要等到<style=highlight>黄昏降...

say:5:1222705004:1.text: If you're curious, why not stay and see it for yourselves?
say:5:1222705004:1.source_cn: 要是你们也感兴趣，不妨留下来一起见证吧。

say:6:1222705005:1.text: Hooray! Chippy is eager to see the king of fish!
say:6:1222705005:1.source_cn: 好耶——！满满也想见见传说中的鱼王！
